evidence: smtpd-on-the-configured-port-with-the-hostname: master.cf.erb:12 declares smtpd on <%=@postfix_port%> (fixture 587); together with main.cf.erb:75 myhostname = smtp_hostname and :10 smtpd_banner = $myhostname ESMTP $mail_name (Ubuntu), the expected greeting '220 smtp.p8test.example.com ESMTP Postfix (Ubuntu)' read from 127.0.0.1:587 is exactly what the baseline would produce

sasl-user-authenticates-through-dovecot (postfix_smtp_base.pp:117-121): the manifest writes /etc/dovecot/users from sasl_users.erb and notifies dovecot; 10-auth.conf (baseline) includes auth-passwdfile.conf.ext, so doveadm auth test p8testuser with the fixture's {PLAIN}p8test-not-a-secret must succeed; the mismatch varies only the password, which must change the verdict

sasl-user-authenticates-through-dovecot (sasl_users.erb:3): the template renders name:password_hash per smtp_users entry, i.e. 'p8testuser:{PLAIN}p8test-not-a-secret' under the fixture, so the passdb lookup with that password must report 'auth succeeded'; the probe tests what this line declares
